pages.text: If you want harmful emissions not to enter the atmosphere or $(l:ecology_inst/page05)greenhouse$(), place a filter on top or in the middle of the $(l:ecology_inst/page06)chimney$().$(br)Each filter can protect against a specific emission, but it requires filter material and also

purification from byproducts to work.$(br)This process can be fully automated using hoppers.$(br)A hopper on any side of the filter loads it with materials. A hopper attached to the bottom extracts all byproducts.$(br)Note that you can use

a single hopper attached to the bottom of the entire chimney/filter/pump pipe to collect byproducts from all filters above.$(br)Each filter also generates a redstone signal. This can be used to control connected $(l:ecology_inst/page04#pump)pumps$() or to activate an "alarm" when the filter is full.
